cases.sentence: Дай израилетянам повеление и скажи им, когда вы войдете в Ханаан, то у ___, которая будет дана вам в удел, будут такие границы.
cases.translation: Command the children of Israel and tell them, 'When you come into the land of Canaan, this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance with these borders.'
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the preposition 'у' (at/about) in the phrase 'у стороны' (concerning a side/part).

cases.sentence: Южная сторона у вас будет простираться от пустыни Цин вдоль границы ___.
cases.translation: Your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the preposition 'вдоль' (along) indicating the direction of the boundary.

cases.sentence: На востоке ваша южная граница будет начинаться от края Соленого ___, проходить на юг к возвышенности Акравима.
cases.translation: Your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the phrase 'край' (edge) in the construction 'край Соленого моря' (edge of the Salt Sea).

cases.sentence: Вашей западной границей будет побережье Великого ___.
cases.translation: For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the noun 'побережье' (coast) in the construction 'побережье Великого берега' (coast of the Great shore).

cases.sentence: Для северной границы проведите рубеж от Великого моря до горы ___, а от горы Ор до лева Хамата.
cases.translation: For the north border you shall mark out a line from the great sea to Mount Hor.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used with the preposition 'до' (to) indicating the endpoint of the boundary line.

cases.sentence: Затем граница спустится по Иордану и дойдет до Соленого ___.
cases.translation: Then the border shall go down to the Jordan and end at the Salt Sea.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the preposition 'до' (to/until) indicating the destination of the border.

cases.sentence: Моисей повелел израилетянам, «Это та ___, которую вы получите в удел по жребию».
cases.translation: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, 'This is the border which you shall inherit by lot.'
cases.explain: The nominative case is used as the predicate noun after the demonstrative pronoun 'та' (that) in the main clause.

cases.sentence: Вот имена тех, кто разделит землю вам в удел, священник Элиазар и ___ сын Навин.
cases.translation: These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun.
cases.explain: The nominative case is used for the subject of the relative clause listing those who would divide the land.

reading.ru: Дай израилетянам повеление и скажи им, когда вы войдете в Ханаан, то у земли, которая будет дана вам в удел, будут такие границы.
reading.question: What was the Lord instructing Moses regarding the land of Canaan?
options: To teach the Israelites not to enter Canaan
To tell the Israelites the specific borders of the land they would inherit
To divide the land equally among all tribes
To establish trade agreements with Canaanite nations
reading.correct: To tell the Israelites the specific borders of the land they would inherit
reading.explain: The Lord commanded Moses to give the Israelites a commandment about the land of Canaan and its borders that would be their inheritance.

reading.ru: На востоке ваша южная граница будет начинаться от края Соленого моря, проходить на юг к возвышенности Акравима, тянуться через Цин и идти на юг к направлению Кадеш-Барнеа.
reading.question: What was the eastern boundary of the southern border of Canaan?
options: From the Red Sea to Mount Hor
From the Salt Sea eastward toward Edom
From the Jordan River to the Mediterranean
From the wilderness of Paran to Mount Sinai
reading.correct: From the Salt Sea eastward toward Edom
reading.explain: The text describes the southern border as starting 'от края Соленого моря, проходить на юг к возвышенности Акравима' (from the edge of the Salt Sea, passing south to the ascent of Akrabbim).

reading.ru: Вашей западной границей будет побережье Великого моря.
reading.question: What served as the western border of the land of Canaan?
reading.explain: The text states 'Вашей западной границей будет побережье Великого моря' (Your western border shall be the coast of the Great Sea), referring to the Mediterranean.

reading.ru: Для северной границы проведите рубеж от Великого моря до горы Ор, а от горы Ор до лева Хамата.
reading.question: What defined the northern border of Canaan?
options: From the Jordan to Mount Sinai
From the Mediterranean Sea to Mount Hor to the entrance of Hamath
From the Dead Sea to Mount Hermon
reading.correct: From the Mediterranean Sea to Mount Hor to the entrance of Hamath
reading.explain: The text describes the northern border as running 'от Великого моря до горы Ор...до лева Хамата' (from the great sea to Mount Hor...to the entrance of Hamath).

reading.ru: Господь повелел отдать ее девяти с половиной родам, потому что семьи родов Рувима, Гада и половина рода Монассии уже получили надел.
reading.question: Why would the land be divided among nine and a half tribes instead of all twelve?
options: Because three tribes refused to enter Canaan
Because the Levites would not receive a portion
Because Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh had already received their inheritance east of the Jordan
Because Moses reserved land for himself and his family
reading.correct: Because Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh had already received their inheritance east of the Jordan
reading.explain: The text explains that Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh families 'уже получили надел' (had already received their inheritance), so the remaining nine and a half tribes would receive the land west of the Jordan.

reading.ru: Вот имена тех, кто разделит землю вам в удел, священник Элиазар и Иисус сын Навин.
reading.question: Who were appointed to divide the land of Canaan among the Israelites?
options: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun
reading.correct: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun
reading.explain: The text explicitly names 'священник Элиазар и Иисус сын Навин' (Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun) as those who would divide the land.
